2026_04_DET_CAR.headline: Detroit’s explosive offense meets a Carolina secondary missing Jaycee Horn
2026_04_DET_CAR.paragraph1: Detroit arrives in Charlotte with Jahmyr Gibbs providing explosive-play stress, while Carolina must reorganize its coverage structure with Jaycee Horn sidelined by a quad injury. That absence puts extra pressure on the Panthers’ pass rush to disrupt timing before Detroit can isolate favorable matchups. Carolina’s offense can help by sustaining possessions and keeping the Lions from repeatedly attacking a depleted secondary. Detroit, meanwhile, has to avoid giving Carolina short fields and make the Panthers drive the length of the field.
2026_04_DET_CAR.model_rationale: Carolina’s secondary depth is a central pressure point, making pass-rush timing and possession control especially important against Detroit’s ability to generate explosive gains.
